findings.title: The access-token ID matcher rejects the expected grant
findings.body: This condition returns `false` when the shortcut equals `expectedGrantShortcut`, so every otherwise well-formed token ID with the expected grant fails the matcher. The updated event assertions for authorization-code, device, refresh, and CIBA flows will therefore fail on valid events; reverse the condition so it rejects mismatches.

findings.title: Grant shortcuts are not constrained to the two-character encoding format
findings.body: The token-ID decoder reads the grant shortcut from exactly two characters, but this API says shortcuts are usually three letters and does not require exactly two. A custom grant factory returning a three-character shortcut will issue IDs that the decoder misparses, causing context decoding to fail for its tokens. Require and validate a two-character shortcut, or make the encoding and decoding length-aware.
